_comment: Manufacturer spec sources (framework/core/spec_sources.py): polite fetching of manufacturer pages and manual PDFs, deterministic per-brand extraction, validation, provenance and an adjudication queue. Resolution, lowest to highest: the module DEFAULTS (fetch politeness, Amazon refusal rules, document limits, source-kind priority; llm and adjudication DISABLED) <- `defaults` <- `profiles.<profile>` <- `by_site.<site>` <- the caller's site_cfg <- `by_agent_id.<agent-id>`. Dicts deep-merge, lists replace (except the Amazon refusal lists, which only ever add to the built-in rules). The profile is the first `profile` key found in by_agent_id, site_cfg, by_site, then defaults. A storage copy at config/spec-sources-config.json replaces this repo file wholesale; a storage copy that exists but cannot be read is reported in config_problems. Only generic values belong in this repo file: a niche's fields, rules, extractor sets and brands are a PROFILE (worked examples for two niches: framework/tests/fixtures/spec_sources/profiles/*.json) and live in the storage copy or the site repo, never in code. Kill switches without a commit: by_agent_id.<agent-id>.llm.enabled=false and .adjudication.enabled=false. LLM calls refuse provider kinds that run a tool-enabled agent session (claude-cli) unless allow_tool_providers is set: route the extracting agent to a provider without tools.

_shape.profiles.<name>.fields.<field>: {kind: quantity|count|text|enum|bool|dimensions, unit (Wh, W, V, A, Ah, mAh, kg, lb, degC, degF, mm, in, dB, Pa, ms, min, h, mL, ...), min, max, rel_tol, abs_tol, required, resolve: conflict|min|max|prefer_kind, adjudicate: model|human (human = only an operator settles its conflicts; use it for safety limits), values: {canonical: [alias regex]}, normalize: alnum|casefold, description, hints: [regex], llm: bool}
_shape.profiles.<name>.rules[]: {name, kind: gte|gt|lte|lt|eq, a: <field>, b: <field>, factor: 1.0, on_fail: conflict|reject, reject: <field>}; a failed rule is a conflict for a human, waived per model only by an operator decision
_shape.profiles.<name>.extractor_sets.<set>[]: {name, kind: pairs|regex|jsonld|plugin|<registered kind>, confidence, scope: {start, end}, when: {kinds: [source kind], url: regex}, fields: {<field>: {labels, exclude_labels, section, origins, value_regex, patterns, pick: first|last|min|max|range_lo|range_hi, unit, constant, values, properties, occurrence: first|all, confidence}}}
_shape.profiles.<name>.default_extractors: [<set>, ...] run for every brand (after the brand's own)
_shape.profiles.<name>.brands.<slug>: {aliases: [..], hosts: [..], extractors: [extractor, ...], use: [<set> | {set, scope, when, confidence}], inherit_defaults: true}
_shape.plugins.module_prefixes: modules a kind=plugin extractor may import ('module:function'); empty = plugins off
_shape.defaults.fetch: {user_agent (must contain robots_token), robots_token, robots_ttl_h: 24, robots_stale_ok_h: 720, min_interval_s: 10, host_min_interval_s: {host: s}, max_crawl_delay_s: 120, max_wait_s: 180, throttle_backoff_s: 60, max_throttle_backoff_s: 3600, timeout_s: 30, max_bytes: 64000000, max_redirects: 5, min_refetch_h: 20, cache_dir: ~/.reusable-agents/spec-sources/cache, max_cache_bytes: 2000000000, max_record_age_d: 180, prune_interval_h: 24, deny_hosts: [host suffix], allow_hosts: [host suffix] (empty = any public host)}; robots.txt is always honoured; only http/https to public addresses
_shape.defaults.documents: {pdf_command: [pdftotext, <known flags>, -, -] (no other program), pdf_timeout_s, min_text_chars: 200, main_only: true, skip_tags: [nav, footer]}
_shape.defaults.refuse: Amazon refusal rules {host_patterns, url_patterns, html_markers, html_min_markers, text_markers}; configured patterns are added to the built-in ones, which no layer can remove, and html_min_markers can only be lowered
_shape.defaults.llm: {enabled: false, batch_size: 10, pool_reserve: 2, model_tier: haiku (admission check and label only), model (explicit override; empty = the agent's routing in config/ai-defaults.json), provider, allow_tool_providers: false, timeout_s, confidence: 0.6, min_quote_chars: 3, max_chars_per_item, max_items_per_run}
_shape.defaults.adjudication: {enabled: false, daily_budget_h: 0.1, max_daily_budget_h: 0.1, est_seconds_per_item: 60, max_items_per_call: 5, max_attempts: 3, model_tier: opus, model (REQUIRED to adjudicate through the routing), provider, allow_tool_providers: false, pool_reserve: 2, prune_after_d: 30, queue_key: agents/{agent_id}/spec-adjudication/queue.json}
_shape.by_site.<site>: {profile: <name>, fetch: {user_agent: '... SpecSourcesBot/1.0; +https://<site>/bot'}, llm: {enabled: true}, adjudication: {enabled: true, model: <strong model id>, provider: <provider without tools>}, ...}
